scope: Twenty prominent technology figures; retrieval names are hypotheses, not approved aliases. Source observations establish public identity and affiliations, not employment on every contribution date.

sources.title: Tesla investor relations: Elon Musk
sources.claim: Identifies Elon Musk as Tesla CEO since October 2008 and SpaceX CEO since May 2002.

sources.title: Andreessen Horowitz: About

sources.title: a16z: primary business legal name

sources.title: Ben Horowitz: a16z career biography
sources.claim: a16z identifies Ben as its cofounder/general partner and describes his Opsware, HP, AOL and Netscape career.

sources.title: Collision: Benjamin E. Horowitz, Venable attorney
sources.claim: Venable identifies Benjamin E. Horowitz as a Washington litigation partner with a 2012 JD; this is an alternative professional profile to the a16z founder.

sources.title: Greylock: Reid Hoffman
sources.claim: Identifies Reid Hoffman as a Greylock partner who joined in 2009 and co-founded LinkedIn in 2003.

sources.title: Asana: Dustin Moskovitz
sources.claim: Identifies Dustin Moskovitz as Asana co-founder; CEO October 2010 through July 2025, board member since 2008.

sources.title: Founders Fund: Peter Thiel
sources.claim: Identifies Peter Thiel as Founders Fund partner, Palantir co-founder/chairman and PayPal co-founder. This is identity context, not a dated employment history.

sources.title: Palantir 2022 proxy: Peter Thiel
sources.claim: Identifies Thiel as president of Thiel Capital since 2011 and Founders Fund partner since 2005.

sources.title: Craft Ventures: David Sacks
sources.claim: Identifies David Sacks as Craft founder/partner and former Yammer founder and PayPal COO; notes his 2025 White House appointment.

sources.title: Collision: David E. Sacks, Duane Morris counsel
sources.claim: Duane Morris identifies David E. Sacks as a Florida real-estate lawyer and special counsel since 2023.

sources.title: Collision: NIH scientist David B. Sacks
sources.claim: NIH identifies a physician and senior investigator named David B. Sacks. This corroborates a scientist collision; the FEC row without an initial is not assigned to a specific scientist.

sources.title: Collision: David Sachs, Pace professor
sources.claim: Pace identifies David Sachs as a professor with a 1978 education doctorate, a distinct academic career.

sources.title: Collision: Judge David G. Sacks, Massachusetts mediator
sources.claim: Boston Law Collaborative describes David G. Sacks as a retired Massachusetts judge with more than 33 years on the bench who provides mediation services.

sources.title: OpenAI: Sam Altman returns as CEO

sources.title: Palantir: Management
sources.claim: Identifies Alexander Karp as Palantir co-founder and chief executive officer.

sources.title: 8VC: Joe Lonsdale
sources.claim: Identifies Joe Lonsdale as founder and managing partner of 8VC.

sources.title: Eric Schmidt: About Eric
sources.claim: Identifies Eric Schmidt as Google's CEO/chairman from 2001 to 2011 and records later technology and philanthropic roles. Historical affiliation is not current employment.

sources.title: SEC issuer filing: Kenneth Goldman biography
sources.claim: Identifies Hillspire LLC as Eric Schmidt's family office; records Goldman's presidency from 2017 to 2022. This supports the affiliation, not a specific current title for Schmidt.

sources.title: Collision: Glue Up CEO Eric L. Schmidt
sources.claim: Glue Up identifies its CEO as Eric L. Schmidt at its McLean, Virginia office, distinguishing the employer/initial context from the former Google leader.
